variants.setup: PRAGMA encoding='UTF-8'; CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,a INTEGER,b INTEGER,r REAL,s TEXT); CREATE INDEX ab ON t(a,b DESC); CREATE INDEX ri ON t(r); CREATE INDEX sn ON t(s COLLATE nocase); CREATE INDEX sr ON t(s COLLATE rtrim); WITH RECURSIVE x(i) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM x WHERE i<1000) INSERT INTO t SELECT i,CASE WHEN i<=900 THEN 0 WHEN i<=910 THEN NULL ELSE i-901 END,i%10,CAST(i%10 AS REAL),CASE WHEN i<=900 THEN 'hot' ELSE 'cold' END FROM x; CREATE TABLE tiny(a TEXT,b TEXT); CREATE INDEX ti ON tiny(a,b); INSERT INTO tiny VALUES('(0)','(0)'),('(1)','(1)'),('(2)','(2)'),('(3)','(3)'),('(4)','(4)'); ANALYZE;

stat4.sql: SELECT id,r,b FROM t WHERE a=0 ORDER BY id
eqp: SCAN t

stat4.sql: SELECT id,r,b FROM t WHERE a=99 ORDER BY id
eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX ab (a=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

stat4.sql: SELECT id,r,b FROM t WHERE a=0 AND b=7 ORDER BY id
eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX ab (a=? AND b=?)

stat4.sql: SELECT id,r,b FROM t WHERE a=0 AND b>7 AND b<=9 ORDER BY id
eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX ab (a=? AND b>? AND b<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

stat4.sql: SELECT id,r,b FROM t WHERE a IN (99,98,NULL) ORDER BY id
eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX ab (a=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

stat4.sql: SELECT id,r,b FROM t WHERE a IS NULL ORDER BY id
eqp: SEARCH t USING INDEX ab (a=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

stat4.sql: SELECT id,r,b FROM t WHERE s='HOT' COLLATE nocase ORDER BY id
eqp: SCAN t

stat4.sql: SELECT id,r,b FROM t WHERE s='hot ' COLLATE rtrim ORDER BY id
eqp: SCAN t

stat4.sql: SELECT r FROM t WHERE r=7.0 ORDER BY id
eqp: SEARCH t USING COVERING INDEX ri (r=?)
